question: The EU Packaging and Packaging Waste Regulation contains a phased implementation timetable, with strict requirements for recyclability, recycled content, minimisation, empty space, reuse and specific packaging bans. There is deep anxiety among smaller businesses and distributors, particularly in relation to whether or not they will be required to register an authorised representative in each of the 27 Member States.
The Commission’s failure to properly communicate the new rules to businesses has led to some reporting a cessation in some of their services due to the lack of clarity. 1.
Can the Commission outline what businesses, if any, are exempt from this new regulation?
Is it necessary for all businesses to register an authorised representative in each EU Member State?
Will the Commission consider a derogation for smaller businesses?
